description.zh: 来自 dsh-market.com 的 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 家族插件与带版本社区插件索引。

description.en: Install every DSH Web plugin in one step.
description.zh: 一键装齐 DSH Web 官方插件

description.en: Reusable members grouped into squads, each started as its own session.
description.zh: 可复用成员组成小队，按需点播成会话

description.en: Watch the session's live browser beside the chat.
description.zh: 右侧看会话驱动的实时浏览器画面

description.en: Render mermaid fences as diagrams
description.zh: 把 mermaid 代码块画成图

description.en: Browse and install skins, pets and presets.
description.zh: 浏览并一键安装皮肤宠物与预设

description.en: Check updates and toggle built-in plugins on the official Plugins page.
description.zh: 官方插件页内检查更新与内置插件开关

description.en: List every session and copy its id in one click.
description.zh: 侧栏列出会话并一键复制 ID

description.en: Browse, enable and edit skills by source.
description.zh: 按来源浏览启停与增删技能

description.en: Drag tasks across columns; cron runs them for real.
description.zh: 拖拽管理任务并按 Cron 真实执行

description.en: Sync GitHub Issues into the task board.
description.zh: 把 GitHub Issues 同步进任务看板

title.zh: 任务看板 SSH 提供方

description.zh: 把钉住的卡片送到远端主机执行

description.en: Bind local squad members as team Agents.
description.zh: 绑定本地智能体成员为团队 Agent

description.en: Switches and configuration for the family's plugins.
description.zh: 家族插件的开关与配置入口

description.en: Register Russian and carry its interface copy.
description.zh: 为界面注册俄语并承载俄语词条

description.en: A minimal preset with its new-session switch.
description.zh: 极简预设与新会话首页开关

description.en: Serve DSH as protocol v1 over one paired WebSocket route for native clients.
description.zh: 为原生手机端提供配对后的协议 v1 通道

description.en: Search, batch-archive and clean up old sessions.
description.zh: 检索、批量归档与清理旧会话

description.en: Run commands and transfer files on remote hosts.
description.zh: 连远程主机执行命令并传文件

description.en: Put the task board on the remote surface.
description.zh: 把任务看板接到远程访问面

description.en: Token usage, balance and cost monitoring.
description.zh: 令牌用量、余额与成本监控

description.en: A persistent bash for Windows sessions.
description.zh: 为 Windows 会话提供常驻 bash

description.en: A one-on-one AI tutor as Skills: bloom-tutor writes a syllabus, then one Markdown lesson at a time in your workspace, and shapes each next lesson from your ??? marks and feedback; six learn-* Skills teach through analogies to what you know, deciding how deep to go, field maps, rough prototypes and explaining it back, with learn-deep running all five. Skills only, no tools or dependencies.
description.zh: 一对一 AI 导师的 Skill 包：bloom-tutor 先写学习大纲，再在工作区每次写一篇 Markdown 课文，下一篇按你标的 ??? 和反馈来调整；另带六个 learn-* 学习方法 Skill，分别用类比已会的知识、判断学多深、领域地图、粗糙原型和讲回来检验来帮你学，learn-deep 一次跑完这五种。只有 Skill，没有工具和依赖。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to the composer: after a turn ends aborted (user pressed stop), interrupted (crash) or errored, the button appears while the composer is empty, and one click sends a continuation notice so the model picks that turn back up. It sits left of the model selector and collapses while you type or attach a file. It does not restore the interrupted output - that partial content was never persisted, so the plugin starts a new turn instead.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被用户中止、崩溃或报错结束后，输入框为空时按钮出现，点一下就发出一条续跑提示，让模型接着把那一轮做完。按钮位于模型选择器左侧，开始输入或添加附件时收窄隐藏，清空后展开回来。不恢复中断时的半截输出——那部分内容从未落盘，插件是新开一轮 turn 重做。

description.en: Claude-Desktop-style Projects: each project is a room with a goal, memory, custom instructions (AGENTS.md) and knowledge files. Every chat started in a project loads them automatically, so you never explain the project twice. You edit the memory in the UI, and agents add and fix entries as they work. Projects page, pinned projects in the sidebar, dsh-style "…" menus (open, new chat, edit, pin, archive, delete), a Project tab beside each chat, and 8 projects_* agent tools. Projects are plain markdown folders that dsh loads natively, with no prompt injection. Zero runtime dependencies, English and Chinese.
description.zh: 类似 Claude Desktop 的 Projects：每个项目是一个独立空间，带目标、记忆、自定义指令（AGENTS.md）和知识文件。在项目里开启的每个对话都会自动加载这些内容，无需重复解释。记忆可在界面中增删改，智能体也会在工作中自动补充和修正。项目页面、侧边栏置顶、与 DSH 一致的「…」菜单（打开、新对话、编辑、置顶、归档、删除）、对话右侧的项目标签页，以及 8 个 projects_* 智能体工具。项目就是普通的 Markdown 文件夹，由 DSH 原生加载，不做提示词注入。零运行时依赖，中英双语。

description.en: An authentication proxy for public DSH Web deployments with password login, captcha, failed-attempt locking, and IP/CIDR allowlists.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 公网部署提供登录认证前置代理，支持账号密码、验证码、失败锁定和 IP/CIDR 白名单。

description.en: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段 550C 全屏开机片头：简易档 4 秒、完整档 16 秒覆写流程，点击或按 Esc 跳过，四套磷光配色。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；桌面窗口右上角那条原生按钮条带在片头期间透明化，按钮像浮在动画上。

description.en: Long-lived role lines for DSH: stable role identity plus a replaceable Session, durable messages, structured handoffs, retire/hibernate and a read-only board. Models positions, not a fixed workflow or DAG.
description.zh: 为 DSH 建立长期角色线：稳定角色身份 + 可替换 Session、持久消息、结构化交接、退役/休眠和只读看板；把线当成岗位，不预设固定流程或 DAG。

title.zh: Agent Plugins市场（兼容Claude Code Plugin）

description.en: Brings the Claude Code plugin-marketplace ecosystem into DSH: add any Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi marketplace git repo as a source and install suites with one click - skills, MCP servers, hooks and slash commands are injected into sessions at runtime, with a market page right inside the Web GUI; zero conversion, zero copying, Claude Code skills work verbatim.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 插件市场生态接入 DSH：任意 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi 市场 git 仓库加为源，即可一键安装 suite，skills、MCP 服务器、hooks 与斜杠命令在运行时注入会话；Web GUI 内置市场页面，零转换零拷贝，Claude Code 技能原样可用。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness LLM provider for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscriptions over the official local Antigravity CLI (agy acp --stdio): zero reverse-engineered endpoints and untouched systemInstruction (avoiding upstream 429 WAF rejections), per-session eager MCP and PTC (run_code) routing, sticky warm worker pool, compaction/rewind sync, Context OS support, accurate single-step context occupancy, and multimodal input.
description.zh: 基于本机已登录的官方 Antigravity CLI (agy acp --stdio) 将 Google AI Pro / Ultra 订阅原生接入 DeepSeek Harness：零逆向抓包与零系统提示词篡改（规避 429 风控），支持按会话隔离的直连 MCP 工具桥与 PTC (run_code) 路由、粘性常驻会话池、历史压缩/回退自动同步、Context OS 增量更新、精准单步上下文水位统计与原生图片输入。

description.en: Editorial diagrams in the chat: the model writes one self-contained HTML file with inline SVG, the conversation previews it inline and exports SVG or PNG; it bundles the diagram-design skill (50 diagram types) and can redraw .drawio / Mermaid / Excalidraw / PlantUML sources. No Python and no Playwright.
description.zh: 在对话里生成编辑设计风格的图表：模型产出一个自包含 HTML（内联 SVG），聊天里直接渲染预览，可一键导出 SVG / PNG；内置 diagram-design skill（50 种图表类型），支持把 .drawio / Mermaid / Excalidraw / PlantUML 源文件重画成新图。不需要 Python，不需要 Playwright。

description.en: Select text in an assistant reply to annotate it; annotations ride along with your next message, hidden in your own bubble behind an Annotations xN chip, and the model replies per Annotation N with hoverable chips. UI and annotation block follow the DSH locale (zh/en); Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends annotations alone; slash commands pass through.
description.zh: 选中助手文字即可批注，回车随消息发送；自己的气泡只显示问题与「批注 ×N」标签，模型按 Annotation N 逐条对照回复（悬浮芯片）；UI 与批注块跟随 DSH 语言切换 zh/en，Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 可直发纯批注，斜杠命令原样放行。

description.en: Accounts-payable three-way match for DeepSeek Harness: import invoices, purchase orders and goods receipts from CSV/XML, apply a 1% default price tolerance that is adjustable in bps, detect duplicate rows and export the Matches / Exceptions workpaper — 4 `ap.*` tools, entirely local, no network and no model call.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地应付三单匹配插件：CSV/XML 导入发票、采购单与收货单，默认 1% 价格容差、可按 bps 调整容差策略并检测重复行，导出 Matches / Exceptions 底稿——4 个 `ap.*` 工具，全程不联网、不调用模型。

description.en: Auto-approves read-only tools, auto-denies dangerous commands, optional full-auto mode.
description.zh: 只读工具自动放行、危险命令自动拒绝，可配置全自动模式。

description.en: Reads an aquaculture input register (a farm header plus one row per record) and applies the bundled versioned rule pack AQ-001..AQ-007 to check completeness and date arithmetic: pond and species per record, quantity and use date for named inputs, use date not after the check date, harvest within the withdrawal period the register states, seed-stock source and quarantine certificate number on stocking records, input type from the configured vocabulary, and unique batch numbers. It lists only the differences it can point to inside the material - never a compliance verdict, never a liability finding.
description.zh: 读取一份水产养殖投入品记录（养殖场表头加每条记录一行），按随包的版本化规则包 AQ-001..AQ-007 核对记录齐备与日期算术：每条记录是否写明塘口与养殖品种、投入量与使用日期、起捕是否满足休药期、投苗是否写明苗种来源与检疫证号、批次编号是否唯一，只列材料内部能逐条指认的差异，不判合规、不认定责任。

description.en: Local-only AR aging for DeepSeek Harness: read one receivables CSV, age invoices from the invoice date and measure overdue from the due date, then output fixed buckets, a customer summary, the overdue ratio and top overdue customers, and export CSV — three `ar.*` tools, no network, no model call, no upload.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地应收账龄分析：读一份应收明细 CSV，按开票日算账龄、按到期日算逾期，输出固定分桶、客户汇总、逾期占比与 Top 逾期客户，并导出 CSV——三个 `ar.*` 工具，不联网、不调用模型、不上传。

description.en: Local-only AR collection for DeepSeek Harness: read the receivables CSV, apply a 7/15/30-day reminder ladder to work out which invoices each customer should be chased for and when, and draft Chinese collection letters plus a collection-list CSV — drafts stay on your machine, no network, nothing sent.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地应收催收：读应收账款 CSV，按 7/15/30 天提醒阶梯为每个客户排出该催哪几票、何时催，生成中文催收函草稿与催收清单 CSV——草稿只写在本机，不联网、不发送。

description.en: Local-only filing-register check: following DA/T 22—2015 and 国务院令第772号, verify row by row that the configured description fields are filled, archive numbers are unique within the register, item numbers run without gaps, retention terms come from the institution's own schedule and creation dates parse and match the register year, and surface items past the transfer deadline — a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; differences only, no verdict, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向档案与文秘的纯本地归档登记表核对：依据《归档文件整理规则》《机关文件材料归档范围和文书档案保管期限规定》（DA/T 22—2015、国务院令第772号），逐行核对著录栏目是否填写、档号是否唯一、件号是否连续、保管期限是否使用本机构期限表用词、形成日期是否可解析并与登记年度一致，报出超过移交期限的条目——只提示差异，原件只读。

description.en: Workspace-based archive management with scoped content search, read-only previews, tags and notes, ZIP backups, lineage graphs, and confirmed permanent deletion with retries. Supports DeepSeek Harness >=0.1.0-rc.7 || 0.2.2-rc.1 || 0.2.2-rc.2 || 0.2.2-rc.3; older Hosts can upgrade straight to the latest plugin without upgrading Harness first.
description.zh: 按工作区管理已归档与未归档会话，支持独立范围正文搜索、只读预览、标签备注、ZIP 备份、来源分支关系图和永久删除确认与重试。支持 DeepSeek Harness >=0.1.0-rc.7 || 0.2.2-rc.1 || 0.2.2-rc.2 || 0.2.2-rc.3，旧版宿主无需先升级 Harness 即可直接升级到最新插件。

description.en: A sidebar artifact shelf: it collects the images, videos, files and links a session delivers into one panel, deduplicated by SHA-256 content hash. Five filter tabs with counts, keyword search, video thumbnails, a lightbox, manual link saving, image paste, uploads up to 25 MB, a one-time backfill of past session logs, and a save_artifact tool the model can call.
description.zh: 侧边栏产物架：把会话交付过的图片、视频、文件和链接收进一处，按 SHA-256 内容哈希去重；五个分类标签带计数、关键词搜索、视频缩略图、灯箱查看、手动收藏链接、粘贴图片、上传文件（≤25MB）、首次启动回填历史会话日志，并提供 save_artifact 工具供模型主动收藏。

description.en: Turn one turn into a prompt playground you can keep revising: rewrite a prompt in place and roll the conversation back to just before it, regenerate a reply from the same prompt while later turns survive, remove a turn from the model context, and render sent prompts as Markdown. Self-contained: the UI and background of all five components (four actions plus one maintenance piece, idle session-log trimming) are bundled inside this package and mounted by six insert rows in its cordis.patch.yml (one is the package's own row), so the plugin list shows a single AI Studio row and installing it pulls in nothing else; each component is still its own npm package, appears as its own row when installed standalone, and one that fails to mount never takes the other four down. The Settings > Plugins > AI Studio panel reports what each component is actually doing (installed / mounted / version), which slots it holds, and the interop contract table. Web and desktop are one implementation - on the desktop app install with --profile desktop.
description.zh: 把一轮对话变成可以反复打磨的 prompt playground：就地改一句提示词并回滚重问、对某条回复原位重跑、把不该留下的一轮从模型上下文删掉、并让发出的提示词按 Markdown 渲染。自包含安装：五个组件（四个动作 + 一个维护：空闲会话日志裁剪）的界面与后台都内置在本包里，由本包的 6 个 insert 行挂载（含本包自己那一行），插件列表里只显示 AI Studio 一行，装本包不会再装任何别的东西；五个组件仍是各自独立的 npm 包，单独安装各自成行、单独可用，任何一个挂载失败都不会带走其余四个。设置 > 插件 > AI Studio 面板如实报告每个组件的实际状态（已安装 / 已挂载 / 版本）、它占用的槽位与互操作契约分配表。Web 与桌面端是同一份实现，桌面版把 --profile web 换成 --profile desktop 即可。

description.en: Assistant photographer that plans the shot (framing, angle, styling, lighting) with you before generating: keeps characters consistent at the prompt level via character profiles. Requires your own ComfyUI service and at least one checkpoint model; generates through a local or remote ComfyUI.
description.zh: 先与用户商量景别、机位、穿搭与光影，确认方案后再出图的助理摄影师插件：按角色档案在提示词层保持人物一致；需自备 ComfyUI 服务与至少一个 Checkpoint 模型，插件直连本机或远程 ComfyUI 生成图片。

description.en: Local-only attendance audit for DeepSeek Harness: read the punch-clock CSV and check every day against an 8-hour standard day, a 3-hour daily overtime cap and a 36-hour monthly overtime cap, reporting per-employee daily hours, overtime, over-limit days, missing punches and short breaks, with a monthly roll-up and reconciliation CSV — no network, no model call, no upload.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地考勤核对：读打卡 CSV，按 8 小时标准工时、3 小时单日与 36 小时月加班上限逐日核对，输出每人日工时、加班、超限日、缺卡与休息不足，按月汇总并导出核对表——不联网、不调用模型、不上传。

description.en: Context health monitoring, content-degradation detection (thinking loops / output repetition), a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict, and zero-model handoff documents. Local-only, no network.
description.zh: 上下文健康监测 + 内容退化检测（思考打转、输出复读）+ 继续 vs 交接成本裁决 + 零模型交接文档。纯本地、零网络。

description.en: Audio-reactive visual background theme for DSH Web and Desktop powered by audioMotion-analyzer. Driven by streaming TTS (dsh-xiaomi-tts), dsh-music-panel, host voice dictation, microphone, browser audio sharing, or Windows loopback capture, with 17 built-in presets, custom preset save and JSON import/export, hold-to-peek settings preview, and an optional idle immersive overlay.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 与 Desktop 的音频响应背景主题，基于 audioMotion-analyzer 渲染居中频谱。支持流式朗读（dsh-xiaomi-tts）、音乐面板（dsh-music-panel）、宿主语音听写、麦克风、浏览器共享音频与 Windows 本机声音采集，内置 17 套视觉预设、自定义预设保存与 JSON 导入导出、设置页按住透视预览以及无操作全屏沉浸遮罩。

description.en: AI audio generation for the dsh web GUI: TTS, music and sound effects through configurable multi-vendor channels (OpenAI-compatible, ElevenLabs, MiniMax, Stability AI and custom), with per-channel model/voice catalogs, an Agent tool and a sidebar panel.
description.zh: AI 音频生成插件：通过可配置的多厂商渠道（OpenAI 兼容、ElevenLabs、MiniMax、Stability AI 与自定义）实现 TTS 文本转语音、音乐与音效生成，提供按渠道模型/音色目录、Agent 工具与侧边栏面板。

description.en: Proactive associative memory: memories recall themselves without the model ever calling a tool. Host watches the conversation, dual-track retrieval (NLP keywords + vector similarity), fixed-boundary injection, prefix-cache friendly. Three-layer auto-consolidation, welcome tour with per-feature switches, recall review, unattended mode, AI greetings & reflections, calendar, cross-tool memory inheritance. Semantic backends selectable: built-in JS tier (e5-small, default) or optional Python BGE-M3 int8 — lexical BM25 always-on as 0GB floor.
description.zh: 主动联想记忆插件：记忆不靠模型调用，自己被唤回——Host 观察情境，NLP 关键词+向量化双轨检索，固定边界注入不破坏前缀缓存。三层记忆自动沉淀、欢迎向导（每项功能当场开关）、唤起回顾、无人值守、AI 问候与每日反思、日历、跨工具记忆继承。语义后端可自选：内置 JS 档（e5-small，默认）或可选 Python BGE-M3 int8，词法 BM25 永远兜底。

description.en: Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent decides allow/deny on the approval answerer chain, with fail-closed fallback and a full session-log audit.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 审批的第二模型 AI 自动复核：一个只读审查子代理在审批应答链上给出允许/拒绝裁决，默认失败关闭，并记录完整会话日志供审计回溯。

description.en: Bank statement reconciliation for DeepSeek Harness: ingest CSV, CAMT.053/054/056 and MT940, match statements against ledger entries one-to-one by amount and date, check CAMT balances and export the Bank / GL / Matches workpaper as xlsx — 6 `bankrec.*` tools, entirely local, no network.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的银行对账插件：CSV、CAMT.053/054/056、MT940 入库，与总账按金额与日期逐笔 1:1 勾对并做 CAMT 余额核对，导出 Bank / GL / Matches 三张表的 xlsx 底稿——6 个 `bankrec.*` 工具，全程本地、不联网。

description.en: Organize Web sidebar projects and conversations with nested virtual folders, direct colored tags and tree-shaped search, without changing working directories. Content search uses DSH's local shared index. Tested only on stock DSH 0.2.2-rc.2, Windows x64, Node.js >=24.9.0 and the web profile.
description.zh: 用嵌套虚拟文件夹、直接彩色标签和树形搜索整理 Web 侧栏项目与会话，不改变真实工作目录。正文检索使用 DSH 本地共享索引；仅实测原版 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2、Windows x64、Node.js >=24.9.0 和 web profile。

title.zh: 投标符合性响应台账核对

description.en: Local-only bid compliance-response register check: following the PRC Tendering and Bidding Law and its implementing regulations, verify that every requirement records a response, that conclusions come from the configured vocabulary, that clause numbers are unique, that the register declares project and bidder, that high-risk clauses carry evidence and that no template placeholder survives in the requirement column — a located difference list; it does not judge bid validity or material deviation, the verdict stays with the evaluation committee, and the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向投标与招标代理的纯本地投标符合性响应台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》，逐条核对每条招标要求是否记录响应、响应结论是否取自已配置的取值清单、条款号是否唯一、台账是否声明项目与投标人、高风险条款是否附证明材料、要求栏是否残留模板占位符，输出可定位的差异清单——不判定投标是否有效或是否构成实质性偏离，结论留给评标委员会，原件只读。

description.en: Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located. It reports differences; it does not judge substantive compliance, never assigns liability and never replaces human review.
description.zh: 面向投标专员与标书编制人的纯本地核对工具：读一份 RequirementsPack 与一份 .docx 投标文件，按词面重合逐条给出「看起来有响应 / 响应可疑 / 定位不到」三种状态；只报告差异，不判合规、不认定责任、不替代人工复核。

title.zh: 投标人资格条件核对表

description.en: Local-only bidder-qualification checklist check: following the PRC Tendering and Bidding Law and its implementing regulations, verify that each condition closes the loop between requirement, the bidder's actual position, the evidence and the conclusion wording, that a disqualifying item records all three, that the header names project and bidder, that condition numbers are unique and that no template placeholder survives — row and column differences with fixes; no compliance or eligibility verdict, originals not verified, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向投标与招标代理的纯本地投标人资格条件核对：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》，逐条核对每条资格条件的要求内容、投标人实际情况、证明材料与结论口径是否闭环，否决项是否三者齐全，表头是否写明项目与投标人，序号是否唯一、要求栏是否残留模板占位符，输出带行号与栏位的差异及补正建议——不判合规、不认定资格、不核验原件，原件只读。

description.en: Five pixel-art cognitive training games to play while your agent runs a task in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 等 Agent 执行任务时，玩几分钟像素风认知训练小游戏。

description.en: A DSH embedded hardware sandbox plugin: place ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED components on a 3D breadboard scene, wire ports with protocol and voltage checks, then run real Python project code in the loop, reading register-level virtual I2C/GPIO readings through a Python shim; fault injection (disconnect, NACK, busy, forced readings) validates exception handling. A second class of virtual hardware — networked devices — reports periodically over HTTP to a real backend (validated full-chain against a live seat-reservation system). Ships 13 hw_* agent tools and a bundled SKILL.md.
description.zh: DSH 嵌入式硬件沙盒插件：在 3D 面包板场景里摆放 ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED 等器件、按协议与电压校验接线，再让真实 Python 项目代码在环运行、经 Python shim 读虚拟 I2C/GPIO 的寄存器级读数；支持故障注入（断线 / NACK / busy / 强制读数）验证异常处理。另有第二类虚拟硬件——联网设备，主动向真实 HTTP 后端周期上报（已在真实智能选座系统全链路验证）。随插件带 13 个 hw_* 工具与一份 SKILL.md。

description.en: Evidence-backed built-in capability Inspector: surfaces provenance, compatibility and structural drift of DSH Web built-ins, with fail-closed toggles for only the nine reviewed UI leaves.
description.zh: Evidence-backed 内置 capability Inspector：展示 DSH Web built-in capability 的 provenance、compatibility 与 structural drift；仅对 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaves 提供 fail-closed 开关。

description.en: Reads a canteen retention ledger (a header plus one row per retained sample) and checks that the four required elements (item name, retained amount, retention time, retention staff) are filled in, that the retained amount reaches 125 g, that the retention time is recorded to the minute and is not in the future, that release happens at least 48 hours after retention, and that cells contain no leftover template text such as XXX or 待填. The 9 single-table rules and 1 cross-table rule (CF-010) are declared in rules/canteen-retention.yaml, and the report separates issues from skipped.
description.zh: 读取一份食堂留样台账（表头加每行一条留样记录），核对品名、留样量、留样时间、留样人员四要素是否填写，留样量是否达到 125 克，留样时间是否记到时分且不在未来，出柜是否距留样满 48 小时，单元格是否残留模板文字；9 条单表规则与 1 条跨表规则（CF-010）声明在 rules/canteen-retention.yaml，报告分 issues 与 skipped 两部分，只列台账本身能指认的差异。

description.en: Read-only MCP server that exposes the DSH plugin certification registry to any MCP client: query a plugin certification grade, its snapshot, and the five-dimension evidence behind it.
description.zh: 只读 MCP 服务器，把 DSH 插件认证注册表开放给任何 MCP 客户端：查询某个插件的认证等级、快照以及支撑该等级的五维证据。

description.en: Switchable identity cards for DSH sessions: identity, tone, code style, and hard constraints injected per session, with a default card, per-session overrides, a visual editor, and single-file import/export.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话绑定可切换的角色卡：身份、语气、代码风格与硬性约束按会话注入，支持默认卡、单会话覆盖、可视化编辑器与单文件导入导出。

description.en: Bring the model subscriptions you already pay for into DSH: seven independent lines (ChatGPT, Kimi, Claude, Command Code, WorkBuddy, MiniMax Code, Google Antigravity), each with its own login and quota card; PKCE OAuth and device-code login, DPAPI/keychain/0600 credential storage, streaming Responses, image generation, Codex search and subagent model authorization.
description.zh: 让 DSH 用上你已订阅的模型：ChatGPT、Kimi、Claude、Command Code、WorkBuddy、MiniMax Code、Google Antigravity 七条线路各自独立登录、独立额度卡片；支持 PKCE OAuth 与设备码登录、DPAPI/钥匙串/0600 凭据存储、流式 Responses、图片生成、Codex 搜索与子代理模型授权。

description.en: Session, workspace and config three-state checkpoints with one-shot /checkpoint and /rewind rollback, a checkpoint tool, interval snapshots and a Settings timeline with pairwise diffs.
description.zh: 会话、工作区、配置三态检查点：/checkpoint 与 /rewind 一键回退，附检查点工具、定时快照，以及设置页带两两 diff 的时间线。

description.en: Verify that a citation exists and that its metadata is right, for DeepSeek Harness: DOI / PMID / arXiv / BibTeX resolution through Crossref, PubMed and arXiv, field-by-field metadata comparison, version/duplicate/retraction observations, content-addressed response snapshots and a REP v1 evidence record. not_found is reported as skipped, never as fa
description.zh: 核对引文是否真实存在、元数据是否正确：经 Crossref / PubMed / arXiv 解析 DOI / PMID / arXiv，逐字段比对标题、作者、年份、期刊与页码，保存响应快照与 REP v1 证据；查不到记为 skipped，绝不伪造。

description.en: Deterministic claim support checking for DeepSeek Harness: verbatim quote spans, number matching, labelled-value contradiction, negation and hedging polarity against the cited sentence, REP v1 evidence/claim/verdict records and SARIF output; a paraphrase is reported as insufficient, never as supported.
description.zh: 确定性论断支撑检查：逐字引文跨度、数字匹配、标签值矛盾、否定与对冲极性对照被引句子，输出 REP v1 证据/论断/裁决记录与 SARIF；改写转述会被报为 insufficient，绝不报为 supported。

description.en: Cross-platform native desktop control (Windows first): screen_shot, screen_read, click, type, scroll, key and app launch, approval-gated and never stealing foreground focus.
description.zh: 跨平台原生桌面控制（优先 Windows）：截图、读屏、点击、输入、滚动、按键与应用启动，全部走审批且不抢前台焦点。

description.en: One-run acceptance check for a DSH plugin: package structure, cordis contract, sandbox smoke test and catalog list, exit codes 0-6.
description.zh: 一次运行验收 DSH 插件：包结构、cordis 契约、一次性沙箱冒烟与目录清单，结论落在退出码 0–6。

description.en: DSH cloud sync for WebDAV, S3, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS and MinIO, syncing profiles, plugin settings and local plugin source archives.
description.zh: 支持 WebDAV、S3、阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS 与 MinIO 的 DSH 云同步插件，可同步 profile、插件配置及本地插件源码归档。

description.en: Migration codemods for DSH plugin APIs across 0.1.3 to 0.2.x, with corridor cards and advisory notes.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件 API 的迁移 codemod，覆盖 0.1.3 至 0.2.x 的升级路径并给出逐段说明。

description.en: Keeps DSH agents from forgetting your requirements during long tasks. After a session resumes, it checks the key conditions and completion evidence again so partial work is not reported as the whole task done.
description.zh: 避免 DSH Agent 在长任务中忘记你的要求。会话恢复后继续核对关键条件和完成依据，防止只做完一部分就报告整个任务已完成。

description.en: Composer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: bracket and quote pairing, wrap-on-selection, closer skipping, empty-pair backspace, and a completion popup over draft words, language tables, workspace files and model ids. Full-width brackets typed through a Chinese IME are converted to half-width ().
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 输入框加补全与编辑：括号与引号自动配对、选中一段再打符号直接框住、跳闭符、空对一次删两侧；补全弹层给本文词、语言词表、工作区文件与模型名，中文候选来自词典（含领域词表、无写死长度上限），打满两个字符自动弹、Tab 接受、回车保持发送。中文输入法打出的全角括号默认换成半角 ()（菜单可关回全角）。标准 DSH bundle 插件：一条命令安装、零第三方运行时、不写文件、不改宿主源码；语言词表在服务端，改过需重启 dsh web。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrows with exact draft and caret restore, browser-local persistence, Ctrl+R reverse search and workspace recall.
description.zh: Web 输入框的终端式历史：边缘优先的方向键、草稿与光标精确还原、浏览器本地持久化、Ctrl+R 反向搜索与按工作区召回。

description.en: Brings the models of the MiniMax Code desktop app (China region) into DSH, zero configuration, no API key. Prerequisite: the MiniMax Code desktop app (China region) installed and signed in on this machine — without a sign-in the model list falls back to two built-in placeholders that cannot actually be called; or skip the app entirely, since the plugin page offers an OAuth device-code sign-in you confirm with your own MiniMax account in a browser. The upstream speaks the standard Anthropic Messages protocol, so DSH's own provider is reused and tool calls, reasoning blocks and context compaction stay Harness-owned; the model catalog is pulled live, so upstream model changes need no plugin update. The interface shows a balance pill in the composer tool row beside the model picker, drawn only while this plugin's models are selected (it hides when another connector's model is selected); the plugin page adds a balance card, this machine's consumption converted to an equivalent cost, the credit batches expiring within 7 and 30 days, and the daily check-in. Credential writes: to renew an expired desktop-app sign-in the plugin writes the app's auth file back atomically, in the app's own format, without changing its generation counter; when signed in through the plugin itself the credential is stored only in the plugin's own ~/.dsh/.minimaxcode-auth.json, never in the app's directory. Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with MiniMax or DeepSeek; it depends on the MiniMax client's non-public interfaces, which a client update may change and break. For learning and research only.
description.zh: 把本机 MiniMax Code 桌面 App（国内版）的模型接入 DSH，零配置、无需 API Key。前置：本机已安装并登录 MiniMax Code 桌面 App（国内版）——否则模型列表只回落为两个内置占位条目、实际调不通；也可不装桌面 App，在插件页面发起 OAuth 设备码登录，在浏览器里用自己的 MiniMax 账号确认。上游是标准 Anthropic Messages 协议，直接复用 DSH 自带的 provider，工具调用、推理块与上下文压缩由 DSH 托管；模型目录从上游实时拉取，模型增减不需要更新插件。界面在输入框工具行（模型选择器旁）显示一枚余额胶囊，仅在选中本插件的模型时出现（切到其他反代插件的模型即隐藏）；插件页面另有余额卡片、本机消耗折算的等效金额、7 天内/30 天内到期的积分批次与每日签到。凭据写入：为续期已过期的桌面 App 登录态，插件会按该 App 自己的格式原子写回其 auth 文件（不改 generation）；用插件自己登录的，凭据只写插件自己的 ~/.dsh/.minimaxcode-auth.json，不碰 App 目录。非官方插件，与 MiniMax、DeepSeek 均无关联；依赖 MiniMax 客户端的非公开接口，客户端更新后接口可能变更导致失效；仅供学习与研究使用。

description.en: Makes a connection a first-class object in DSH: sessions are nodes, a connection is the container, and cards mount per connection. One connection joins two sessions, so each side can read the other's work state, share a convention box for interfaces and ownership, and send messages at four urgency levels; permissions are per direction (read-only / suggest / write) and the two directions are independent. Cards are connection-level plugins: the tools a card registers are reachable only by sessions on that connection, through one resident bridge tool, with visibility scoped per side; a card carries its own dependencies in its own directory and writes nothing to the DSH profile. Connections, permissions and installed cards live under $DSH_HOME/connection-cards/, and connections are restored on restart.
description.zh: 把「连接」做成 DSH 里的一等对象：会话是节点，连接是容器，卡片按连接挂载。一条连接连接两个会话，两端可以互相读取对方的工作状态、共用一份记录接口与分工的「公约盒」，并按四档紧急度互发消息；权限分方向（只读／建议／写入），两个方向互不影响。卡片是挂在连接上的连接级插件：卡片注册的工具只有这条连接上的会话能通过一个常驻桥接工具调用，可见范围可以按端限定；卡片自带依赖、装在独立目录，不写入 DSH profile。连接、权限与已安装卡片都保存在 $DSH_HOME/connection-cards/ 下，重启后连接会恢复。

description.en: Claude-style MCP connectors: a Connectors page in the sidebar (also Settings → Connectors) adds any MCP server — remote (Streamable HTTP with SSE fallback) with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE sign-in, a token or custom headers, or a local command over stdio. Tools appear in every chat as mcp__<id>__<tool>, no YAML and no restart per server. Sign-in returns to the address you opened DSH at, so it also finishes when DSH runs on a headless server. Tokens live in DSH's credential store, survive restarts and refresh on their own; dropped connections reconnect; single tools can be switched off; imports mcpServers JSON from Claude Desktop or Cursor.
description.zh: 像 Claude 一样的 MCP 连接器：侧边栏的「Connectors」页面（也在 设置 → Connectors）可添加任意 MCP 服务器——远程服务器（Streamable HTTP，自动回退 SSE）支持 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 登录、令牌或自定义请求头，也可添加本地命令（stdio）。工具以 mcp__<id>__<tool> 出现在所有对话中，无需编辑 YAML，添加服务器无需重启。登录会回到你打开 DSH 的地址，服务器无界面部署时也能自动完成。令牌存放在 DSH 凭据存储中，重启后保留并自动刷新；断线自动重连；可逐个关闭工具；可导入 Claude Desktop / Cursor 的 mcpServers JSON。

description.en: Scans a construction project's document archive directory and checks, by relative path and file name, whether each of the 12 required document kinds listed in the rule library is present, listing missing documents with rule id, category and cited clause. It also reports two set-level problems: multiple copies of the same document (possible revision leftovers) and zero-byte files. It reads directory structure and file names only, never file contents, and outputs a Markdown list plus a structured resultJson.
description.zh: 扫描一个施工项目的资料归档目录，按相对路径与文件名核对规则库列出的 12 类规定资料是否存在，并按规则号、类别、依据条款给出缺件清单；同时报告同一资料出现多份（可能残留旧版本）与零字节文件两类集合级问题。只看目录结构与文件名、不打开文件内容，输出 Markdown 清单与结构化 resultJson。

description.en: A one-stop DeepSeek Harness context insight and visualization plugin: a Context dashboard and browser plus /context command that reveal composition, history evolution, compaction/prune events, and token cost per message and image.
description.zh: 一站式 DeepSeek Harness 上下文洞察与可视化插件：Context 面板与浏览器加 /context 命令，透视上下文构成、历史演进与压缩/剪枝等事件，并展示消息与图片的 token 占用。

description.en: Local-only contract expiry register for DeepSeek Harness: register contracts with seven fields per row, then split them as of a date into expired / in-renewal-window / due-within-N-days groups with remaining days and export CSV — date and registry arithmetic only, no contract parsing, no reminders, no network.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地合同到期登记：一行七个字段登记合同，按指定日期分成已过期 / 续签窗口 / N 天内到期三组互斥清单并计算剩余天数，导出 CSV——只做日期与登记表计算，不解析合同正文、不发提醒、不联网。

description.en: Host-side check for DeepSeek Harness aimed at legal teams and contract administrators: read a contract-stance ledger (contract header plus one row per clause), apply a rule library of verbatim citations, and list which row, which column and what is missing; the original file is never modified and compliance is not judged.
description.zh: 面向法务与合同管理员的主机端核对插件：读取一份「合同表头 + 每条款一行」的立场台账，按逐字引用的规则库列出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」，不改原件、不判定合规。

description.en: Announces estimated turn costs in CNY in DSH Web using bundled local audio, defaulting to the Dabaifan voice with an optional Alipay voice; can prefer per-turn costs from dsh-cost-meter or estimate from usage and model prices. Provides volume, quiet hours and a minimum amount. No TTS service; estimates are not billing records. Preview once in settings to unlock browser audio; requires an open page and may be delayed in background tabs. Code is MIT; the bundled Alipay clips come from Reathin/XVoice (which ships no licence), the Dabaifan voice is a second-hand creation cloned from MiMo and the icon is fan art, so these assets are not redistributed under the plugin's MIT grant and are for personal, non-commercial use with this plugin only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 回合结束后用随包本地音频播报人民币估算费用，默认大白饭音色，可切换支付宝，也可优先读取 dsh-cost-meter 的每轮费用或按用量和单价估算。提供音量、静音时段和最低播报金额设置；不调用 TTS 服务，金额不代替真实账单。需先在设置页试听以解锁浏览器音频，页面关闭不播报，后台可能延迟。代码 MIT；随包的支付宝音效片段来自未附许可证的 Reathin/XVoice，大白饭音色为 MiMo 克隆的二次创作，图标为网友二创，这些素材不随本插件以 MIT 授权再分发，仅限随插件个人非商业使用。

description.en: Customs declaration document consistency check for DeepSeek Harness: reads a declaration document ledger (Chinese or English headers) and applies the bundled versioned rule pack CD-001..CD-007 to required columns, HS-code and currency forms, unique document numbers, gross weight not below net weight, parseable dates and template placeholders. It lists only differences it can point to inside the material — never a compliance verdict.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的数据型核查插件：读取一份报关单证台账（栏名中英文皆可），按随包的版本化规则包 CD-001..CD-007 核对关键栏目、商品编码与币制形式、单证编号唯一性、毛重不低于净重、日期可解析与模板占位符；只列材料内部能逐条指认的差异，不判合规、不认定责任。

description.en: Deterministic data profiling, cleaning and verification: a DAMA-style scorecard, content-hash dedupe, metric expectations and drift checks, exposed as tools and a capability seam.
description.zh: 确定性数据剖析、清洗与校验：DAMA 式评分卡、内容哈希去重、指标期望与漂移检查，以工具与能力接缝对外提供。

description.en: Dataset documentation for DeepSeek Harness: bounded CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL profiling (types, missingness, cardinality), redacted PII detection by column name and value pattern (emails, phones, national IDs, IPs), a Datasheet-style card with missing-section warnings, Markdown/JSON/SARIF output and REP evidence that stores the analysis but never the raw
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的数据集文档：对 CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL 做有界画像（类型、缺失、基数），按列名与值模式检测并脱敏 PII，生成带缺节提示的 Datasheet 式卡片，输出 Markdown/JSON/SARIF 与只存分析不存原文的 REP 证据。

description.en: A five-mode deep reading plugin (quick / deep / map / feynman / book) for links and files, with batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, md / mm / html exports, and Web UI tool-result cards plus a reading panel.
description.zh: 五种模式精读插件（quick / deep / map / feynman / book），支持公众号链接与文件输入、批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明，导出 md / mm / html，Web UI 提供工具结果卡片与精读面板。

description.en: Delete sessions straight from the ... menu on a sidebar conversation row: the log, workspace accounting and projection cache go to the system trash by default, so a wrong click is recoverable - turn that switch off in settings for a permanent delete, and the confirmation dialog says which one you are getting. Whether the dialog appears is a settings option as well, with Shift-click to force it once. Sub-sessions follow their parent (delete them together, or tick the ones you want in the dialog). Multi-select batch delete shows live progress in the sidebar footer and puts failed rows back, still selected. Optionally the files a conversation produced move into a quarantine folder instead of being deleted (off by default, and files inside a git repo are left alone by default). Deleting the session you have open lands you on a new one. The host route is loopback-only, an occupied session is polled at most 12 times at 200ms intervals (about 2.2s) and then refused with 409 (busy) rather than racing the active writer, bilingual, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行的 ... 菜单里直接删除会话：会话日志、工作区记账与投影缓存默认放进系统回收站（删错能还原），在设置页关掉开关才是永久删除，确认框的文案跟着开关走；要不要弹确认框同样在设置页改，按住 Shift 点击可临时强制弹出。子会话跟着父会话一起处理（设置里勾选就一起删，否则在弹窗里逐个勾）。会话菜单的「多选」批量删除在侧栏页脚显示实时进度，失败的行恢复显示并保持选中。可选把这个对话产出的文件移进隔离夹（默认关闭，git 仓库内的文件默认不碰）。删掉当前打开的会话会自动落到一个新会话。宿主路由仅限本机回环；被占用的会话最多按 200ms 间隔探测 12 次（约 2.2 秒），仍占用就返回 409（busy），不与活跃写者竞争；中英双语，零依赖。

description.en: Reads a demurrage and detention ledger (a header plus one row per container) and checks that each row carries at least a container number or bill-of-lading number, that the free-time start date and return date parse and are in the right order, that overdue days equal the date difference minus free time, that the amount equals overdue days times the rate, that the currency is a three-letter code, that container numbers are unique and that the remarks column has no unreplaced template placeholders. Free time and rates come from the ledger itself; computation is purely in-memory with no network call and no model call, and only differences are listed.
description.zh: 读取一份滞箱费台账（表头加每个集装箱一行），核对每行是否至少填写箱号或提单号、免箱期起算日与还箱日期是否可解析且先后成立、超期天数是否等于两个日期之差减去免箱期、金额是否等于超期天数乘以费率、币制是否为三位字母代码、箱号是否重复、备注栏是否残留未替换的模板占位符；免箱期与费率一律取自台账本身，纯内存计算、不联网、不调用模型，只列差异。

description.en: TickTick (Dida365) task bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a session-header task panel with filtering, quick add, complete, delete, due dates and drag reorder, 11 ticktick_* agent tools, a plugin settings card and a typed Remote service, all over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的滴答清单（TickTick / Dida365）任务桥：会话头部待办面板支持筛选、快加、完成、删除、改期与拖拽排序，另有 11 个 ticktick_* agent 工具、插件页配置卡与类型化 Remote 服务，全部走官方滴答 MCP 端点。

description.en: Local-only data-management-plan tooling for DeepSeek Harness: a ten-section scaffold (data description, collection, documentation, storage/backup, security, sharing, retention, roles, legal basis, costs) with prompts, completeness and internal-consistency checks (personal data vs open sharing, retention minimum, backup, repository/licence/DOI, contact), and a Markdown export you can paste into the funder's form — internal consistency checks only, not funder-template certification; no network, no model call, no upload.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地数据管理计划工具：按十个章节（数据描述、收集、文档、存储/备份、安全、共享、保存、角色、法律依据、费用）给出带提示语的脚手架，核对章节齐备性与内部一致性（个人数据与开放共享、最短保存期、备份、仓库/许可证/DOI、联系人），并导出可粘贴进资助方表格的 Markdown——只做内部自洽核对，不替代资助方模板，不联网、不调用模型、不上传。

description.en: Turn PDF / HTML / LaTeX / Markdown documents into locatable evidence surfaces for DeepSeek Harness: content-addressed snapshots of the original bytes plus the extracted text, page/section/paragraph/char anchors, table grids and a REP v1 evidence record. It does not render, read, translate or judge — it produces coordinates other plugins can cite.
description.zh: 把 PDF / HTML / LaTeX / Markdown 文档转成可定位的证据面：对原始字节与提取文本做内容寻址快照，提供页/节/段/字符锚点、表格网格与 REP v1 证据记录。只产出坐标，不做渲染、阅读、翻译或判断。

description.en: Delivery quality gate for DeepSeek Harness: grill the requirements, write failing tests before green, review against the same replayable session log, and let a four-stage gate decide deliverable vs rework.
description.zh: 交付质量门禁：动笔前审讯需求，先写失败测试再转绿，用同一份可重放的会话日志做对抗评审与逐维度核对，最后由四阶段门禁给出可交付/返工裁决。

description.en: Local-only emergency-drill-script check: following the Basic Specification for Emergency Drills of Production Safety Accidents, verify that each step records its drill phase or script text and a commander, that response levels come from the configured vocabulary, that action steps list their resources, that step durations total the planned duration, that key checkpoints state judgement conditions, that step numbers are unique and that the header names the drill and organising unit — a row-by-row, column-by-column list of what differs and how to fix it; differences only, no verdict, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向应急管理的纯本地应急演练脚本核对：依据《生产安全事故应急演练基本规范》，核对每个环节是否填写演练阶段或脚本内容、是否明确指挥人、响应级别是否取自配置口径、有脚本动作的环节是否列明所需资源、各环节计划时长合计是否等于演练总时长、关键节点是否写明判定条件、序号是否重复、表头是否声明演练名称与组织单位，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么、怎么补」的清单——只提示差异，不作出定性结论，原件只读。

description.en: EIA technical guideline applicability check for DeepSeek Harness: reads an EIA guideline applicability table (a project header plus one row per assessment element) and applies the bundled versioned rule pack EG-001..EG-007 to the traceability of elements, guideline names and execution standards. It lists only differences it can point to inside the material and never issues a compliance verdict.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的数据型核查插件：读取一份环评导则适用性核对表（项目表头加每条评价要素一行），按随包的版本化规则包 EG-001..EG-007 核对要素、导则名称与执行标准的可追溯性；只列材料内部能指认的差异，不判合规、不认定责任。

description.en: Chinese e-invoice (OFD/XML) inbox for DeepSeek Harness: ingest, parse, deduplicate, queue for review, record receipts and archive locally — 10 `invoice.*` tools, nothing uploaded and no tax-bureau or model call.
description.zh: 中文电子发票（OFD/XML）收件箱：导入、解析、去重、进入复核队列、登记回执并本地归档——10 个 `invoice.*` 工具，数据不出本机。

description.en: Emergency response plan check for DeepSeek Harness: check plans against the Guidelines for the Preparation of Emergency Response Plans for Production Safety Accidents of Production and Business Units and the Measures for the Administration of Emergency Response Plans for Production Safety Accidents (GB/T 29639-2020; State Administration of Work Safety Order No. 88). Flags discrepancies only and makes no legal conclusion.
description.zh: 面向安全生产的纯本地应急预案要素核对：依据《生产经营单位生产安全事故应急预案编制导则》《生产安全事故应急预案管理办法》（GB/T 29639-2020、国家安全生产监督管理总局令第88号），按综合应急预案、专项应急预案与现场处置方案三类要素清单分别核对齐备性，标题存在而标题下无正文的按缺失报出，每条差异定位到页或行——只列字面差异，不判合规、不作安全定性，原件只读。

description.en: Long-term memory for dsh: what the AI remembers is kept as plain markdown files (by default in ~/.dsh/.engramory-memory/) that you can open and edit at any time. The memory index MEMORY.md, which lists only note names, is brought into the conversation automatically, and the AI opens a note when it needs the detail. A write through dsh's file tools that would leave the index over 200 lines or 25 KB, and longer on that count than before, is refused before it lands, and the AI is asked to compact first (a write that shrinks an over-cap index still goes through; shell writes are not intercepted). It ships its own rules for what to remember and how, reminds the AI to save what matters before dsh compacts a long conversation, and adds a read-only Memory page to the sidebar that flags broken index links and notes missing from the index. An optional companion mode lets a chat persona keep shared moments, upcoming plans and its own changes. The memory index is sent to your model provider as part of the conversation; the plugin goes online only when you click Check for updates, to read the latest version number from npm; uninstalling leaves the memory files in place.
description.zh: 长期记忆插件：AI 记住的东西存成普通 markdown 文件（默认在 ~/.dsh/.engramory-memory/），随时能打开看、能改。对话里自动带上记忆索引 MEMORY.md（只列笔记名字），AI 要细节再去读那条笔记；通过 dsh 的文件工具写索引时，若写完后行数超过 200 行且比原来多、或字节数超过 25 KB 且比原来大，写入前拒绝并让 AI 先压缩（已超限时往小里改照常放行；shell 写入不在拦截范围内）。自带记什么、怎么记的规则，对话快要被压缩时提醒 AI 先存记忆；侧栏多一个只读的「记忆」页，标出索引里的坏链接和没进索引的笔记。可选大肥鱼模式，给陪聊角色记共同经历、约定和角色自己的变化。记忆索引会随对话发给所用的模型服务；只有点「检查更新」时才访问 npm 查版本号，其余时间不联网；卸载不删除记忆文件。

description.en: Reads an essay scoring rubric (a student header plus one row per criterion) and checks that each criterion has a name or level description, that no score exceeds the criterion maximum, that criterion scores add up to the rubric total, that scored criteria carry a source locator, that criterion numbers are unique and that the header names the student and rubric version. Reports only discrepancies it can point to in the material, without judging essay quality or score correctness, and outputs a Markdown report plus reportJson with checks it could not run listed under skipped.
description.zh: 读取一份作文评分表（学生表头加每个评分项一行），核对每个评分项是否填写名称或等级描述、得分是否不超过该项分值、各项得分合计是否等于量表总分、给出得分的项是否留下原文定位、序号是否唯一、表头是否声明学生与量表版本；只列材料里能逐条指认的差异，不判断作文好坏或分数是否恰当，输出 Markdown 报告与 reportJson，未执行的检查逐条列入 skipped。

description.en: Pure-local eval toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: lint an eval-pack structure, grade case by case with normalised exact JSON equality, summarise a run and estimate pass@k without bias; all four tools are read-only, with no network, no model calls and no uploads.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地评测工具包：lint 评测样本结构、按规范化 JSON 精确比对逐例评分、汇总一次运行并无偏估计 pass@k；四个工具全部只读，不联网、不调用模型、不上传数据。

description.en: Local-only evidence/exhibit-list check: map the facts to prove onto the evidence list, verify each row's completeness, sources, dates and exhibit numbers, mark empty cells, repeated exhibit numbers and placeholder text, and report a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list with rule IDs — differences only, no verdict, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向举证与案件的纯本地证据清单核对：把待证事实映射到证据，逐行核对清单的齐备、来源、日期与编号，标出空栏、重复证据编号与【待填】占位符，按规则 ID 输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的差异清单——只提示差异，不作出定性结论，原件只读。

description.en: Reconciliation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: join two Excel/CSV sheets on a declared key and compare declared fields within declared tolerances, producing a Markdown report, JSON result and diff workbook; amounts are compared in integer minor units, duplicated keys are skipped whole rather than paired arbitrarily, and it reports differences without adjudicating them.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的对账插件：按声明的主键连接两份 Excel/CSV 表，按声明字段与容差逐项比较，输出 Markdown 报告、JSON 结果与差异工作簿；金额用整数最小单位比较，主键重复时整键跳过而不是随手配对，只列差异不替人裁决。

title.zh: 出口管制物项台账核对

description.en: Local-only export-control item-register check: following the Export Control Law of the PRC, verify that each item states whether it is controlled, that controlled items carry a licence number and issue date, that end use or end user and destination are recorded, that licence numbers do not repeat within the register, that control categories come from the institution's vocabulary and that no template placeholder survives — a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; internal differences only, it does not decide whether an item is controlled or licensed, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向出口管制合规的纯本地物项台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》，逐条核对每条物项是否在「是否受控」栏写明是否受控、受控物项是否填写许可证号与发证日期、最终用途或最终用户与最终目的地是否至少填写、许可证号是否在同一台账内重复、管制类别是否取用本机构口径、物项名称栏是否残留占位符，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只列台账内部差异，不判定物项是否受控、是否需要许可，原件只读。

description.en: The DeepSeek Harness client edition of the Famling pixel pet: Tinglan / Ragdoll cat / Golden Retriever animations in the sidebar footer, a right-click or Shift+F10 hierarchical menu, a role-as-theme content center and unified settings (quiet hours, reduce motion, temporary hide); zero persistent buttons, local-only preferences, no network and no script execution. License: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 (non-commercial) with CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 artwork; an unofficial project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.
description.zh: Famling 像素桌宠的 DeepSeek Harness 客户端版：侧栏左下角显示汀岚 / 布偶猫 / 金毛动画，右键或 Shift+F10 打开分级菜单，角色即主题的内容中心与统一设置（安静时段、减少动态、暂时隐藏）；默认零常驻按钮，偏好只存本机，不联网、不执行脚本。许可：PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0（非商用）与美术素材 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；非官方项目、不关联 DeepSeek。

description.en: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: context engineering, latency profiling and cache behavior reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的性能剖析与 LLM 缓存诊断：上下文工程、延迟剖析与缓存行为报告。

description.en: Local-only FMEA worksheet check for quality and reliability engineering: following published FMEA method standards, verify element completeness and the arithmetic that links severity, occurrence and detection to the risk priority number, and report a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list — inconsistencies only, no judgement on whether the ratings are appropriate, the original is never modified.
description.zh: 面向质量与可靠性工程的纯本地 FMEA 分析表核对：参照公开的 FMEA 方法标准，核对分析表的要素齐备性，以及严重度、发生度、探测度与风险顺序数之间的算术一致性，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只报告不一致之处，不评价评分数值是否恰当，原件不改。

title.zh: 预测偏差与考核台账核对

description.en: Local-only forecast-accuracy assessment-register check: against the institution's configured definition and charge formulas (currency codes following ISO 4217), verify that the period, subject and market are stated, that forecast, actual and accuracy values parse as numbers, that the stored accuracy and assessment charge agree with the configured formulas, that the currency is a three-letter code, that no period repeats and that no placeholder survives in the remark column — differences only; it does not judge whether the method applies or a charge should be made, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向合同与考核结算的纯本地预测准确率考核台账核对：依据本机构配置的定义式与算式（币制写法参照《表示货币的代码》），核对考核期、考核对象与市场类型是否写明，预测值、实际值与准确率是否可解析为数值，台账所填准确率与考核费用是否与配置的公式相符，币制是否三位字母代码、考核期是否重复、备注栏是否残留占位符——只列差异，不判定考核办法适用性或费用是否应当收取，原件只读。

description.en: Free multi-engine web search: 37 engines available, with 28 actually covered by the default auto-fallback chain (the 5 HTML SERP engines stay out by default, and the per-call billed OpenAI / Gemini / Claude / Metaso engines run only when explicitly named); time filtering, concurrent multi-source search, platform search, web_fetch and a web settings panel. On startup it probes the egress region via cloudflare, ip.sb and ipinfo to pick the default engine, and queries are sent to the selected third-party engines. Installation takes over web.searchProvider as ddg and web.fetchProvider as fs-quality-fetch in the profile's cordis.patch.yml; disabling or uninstalling does not restore them, so remove those two lines under - id: web or the host reports configured web provider "ddg" is not registered. It is mutually exclusive with other plugins that set searchProvider; the last applied layer decides the actual search.
description.zh: 免费多引擎网络搜索：37 个引擎可选，默认自动回退链实际覆盖 28 个（5 个 HTML SERP 引擎默认不参与，OpenAI / Gemini / Claude 与 Metaso 四个按次计费引擎只在显式点名时运行）；支持时间过滤、多源并发、平台搜索、web_fetch 与网页设置面板。启动时会向 cloudflare、ip.sb、ipinfo 探测出口地区来选择默认引擎，查询会发送给所选第三方引擎。安装后会把 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 中 web.searchProvider 接管为 ddg、web.fetchProvider 接管为 fs-quality-fetch；停用或卸载不会自动还原，需要手动删除 - id: web 下的这两行，否则宿主会报 configured web provider "ddg" is not registered。与其它设置 searchProvider 的搜索插件互斥，最后生效的一层决定实际搜索。

description.en: Token-gated reverse proxy for remote access: use DeepSeek Harness over public tunnels or LAN from phones and other devices, with settings, credentials and file access kept working and per-device sessions.
description.zh: 令牌门控反向代理：公网隧道或局域网下，在手机等设备上远程使用 DeepSeek Harness，设置、凭据与文件访问保持可用，支持按设备会话。

description.en: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds: public-source collection, manager and holdings analysis, performance decomposition and sealed source snapshots.
description.zh: 面向中国公募基金的确定性研究报告：公开源采集、基金经理与持仓分析、业绩归因，以及可封存的源快照。

description.en: Interactive UI inside assistant replies via the dsh-ui fence: layouts, charts, tables, forms, quizzes, Mermaid, 3D and native audio/video. Dual-channel rendering covers stock DSH and newer builds, with streaming render, panel docking and component actions that loop back to the model.
description.zh: 给模型输出配交互式 UI：助手回复内联渲染 dsh-ui 围栏（布局、图表、表格、表单、Mermaid、3D、原生音视频），双通道渲染兼容原版 DSH 与新构建，支持流式渲染、面板停靠与组件交互回传模型。

description.en: GitHub PRs, reviews, issues and CI for DeepSeek Harness: create, review, merge and search PRs, read and write issues, CI compound actions, a polling review bot and a status-check gate; every write waits behind a tools/pre-execute approval gate and tokens never reach the log.
description.zh: GitHub 集成：创建、审查、合并与搜索 PR，读写 issue，附带 CI 复合动作、轮询式审查机器人与状态检查门禁；每个写操作都先经 `tools/pre-execute` 闸门等待人工批准，token 不写入日志。

description.en: Local-only receipt-and-handling register check: following 中办发〔2012〕14号, verify that each handling step records a handler, that receipt and completion dates parse and follow each other, that completion falls inside the deadline the register itself records, that statuses come from the configured vocabulary, that each document number is registered once and that the header declares both title and receipt date — a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; differences only, no overdue or responsibility verdict, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向办公室与文秘的纯本地收文登记与办理环节核对：依据《党政机关公文处理工作条例》（中办发〔2012〕14号），核对每个办理环节是否填写承办人、收文与办结日期是否可解析且先后成立、办结是否落在台账自己写入的办理期限内、状态是否取自配置的取值清单、文号是否只登记一次、表头是否同时声明标题与收文日期，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只提示差异，不判定是否超期或应由谁负责，原件只读。

description.en: Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the year is written in and the numbering pattern. Reports what does not match the format; it does not judge the document's content.
description.zh: 依据公开的党政机关公文格式标准，核对公文的文种与发文字号——包括年份所用的括号形式与编号格式。只报告与格式不符之处，不评价公文内容。

description.en: Chinese grant application check for DeepSeek Harness: a 19-item starter checklist (title, abstract, science-question attribute A-D, rationale, goals, content, approach, technical route, innovation, feasibility, foundation, conditions, team, budget, budget notes, ethics, data sharing, limits, references), budget arithmetic and structure validation (equipment/operating/labor/indirect costs and total consistency), and an application-materials pack scan (application, budget table, ethics, commitment letter, CV, attachments), with JSON/Markdown output and REP evidence. A keyword checklist, not a review verdict.
description.zh: 中文基金申请书检查：19 项起步清单（项目名称、摘要、科学问题属性、立项依据、目标、内容、方案、技术路线、创新、可行性、基础、条件、团队、预算、预算说明、伦理、数据共享、限项、参考文献）、预算算术与结构校验，以及申请材料包扫描，输出 JSON/Markdown 与 REP 证据；是关键词清单，不是评审结论。

description.en: Local-only PPE allocation-table check: verify that each row fills the product name, specification and configured quantity, that the quantity parses as a number above zero and reconciles with the stated headcount and the per-person factor, that the issue date falls inside the plan period and expiry is later than issue, and that the table covers the required product categories — a row-by-row, column-by-column list of what differs and how to fix it; differences only, no adequacy verdict, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向安全管理与劳保管理的纯本地劳动防护用品配置表核对：核对每行是否填写品名、规格型号与配置数量，配置数量能否解析为大于零的数字并按配置人数与每人基数推算，发放日期是否落在配置期间内、有效截止是否晚于发放日期，以及配置表是否覆盖本机构要求的用品类别，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么、怎么补」的清单——只列差异，不判定防护等级是否足够，原件只读。

description.en: API response gzip plugin for DSH Web GUI: enables gzip on /api responses for remote / low-bandwidth links, fixing session-history loads that fail on the timeout of large uncompressed responses; SSE, zip and already-encoded responses are passed through untouched, with no global side effects.
description.zh: /api 响应 gzip 压缩插件：为远程 / 低带宽链路开启 /api 响应压缩，解决会话历史因大响应无压缩而超时加载失败的问题；SSE / zip / 已编码响应自动豁免，无全局副作用。

description.en: Local-only hazardous-chemical register check for safety management: verify that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the stated threshold, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated, and report a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list — differences only for human review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.
description.zh: 面向安全管理的纯本地危险化学品台账核对：核对每种物质是否载明危险性类别、储存量能否解析、是否记录临界量、重大危险源判定与该储存量相对台账自述临界量的关系是否一致、是否载明安全技术说明书编号、CAS 号是否重复，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只列出差异供人复核，不判定某单元是否构成重大危险源。

description.en: HAZOP worksheet check: node, guide word, process parameter, deviation and cause, plus required fields and locally configured risk levels.
description.zh: HAZOP 分析表核对：节点、引导词、工艺参数、偏差与原因，以及必填栏目与本机构风险等级口径。

description.en: Local-only hazard-register mapping check: following 应急管理部令第10号, map each hazard row onto candidate clauses by literal keyword match over the register's own columns, and report rows matching no clause, rows under other rules (hazardous chemicals, fire, gas, special equipment), rows missing remediation-closure fields and clauses hit by too many rows, naming the clause behind every finding — human review only, no major-hazard verdict, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向安全管理与隐患排查的纯本地隐患台账映射核对：依据《工贸企业重大事故隐患判定标准》（应急管理部令第10号），按台账实际列名把每行隐患按字面关键词映射到候选条款，报出未匹配任何条款的行、属其他规定管辖（危险化学品、消防、燃气、特种设备）的行、缺少整改闭环字段的行与命中条目过多的条款，每条注明依据条款——只供人工复核，不判定是否构成重大隐患，原件只读。

description.en: Local-only commodity-classification register check for customs and trade compliance: verify the hierarchy and prefix agreement of chapter (2 digits), heading (4), subheading (6) and commodity code (10), check that each code matches its subheading and that a tariff version is declared, and report a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list — differences only for human review; it does not decide the classification.
description.zh: 面向关务与贸易合规的纯本地商品归类台账核对：逐份核对章（2 位）、品目（4 位）、子目（6 位）与商品编号（10 位）的层级与前缀一致性，检查商品编号与子目是否对得上、税则版本是否声明，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只列出差异供人复核，不代为判定归类。

description.en: Local-only ICD coding check for medical-record coders: following GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes, check each coded episode's ICD-10 diagnosis and ICD-9-CM-3 procedure codes for form, duplicates, dagger-and-asterisk combinations and field completeness, and report a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list — it flags the pairs a coder should review, does not resolve them, and the coding decision stays with the coder.
description.zh: 面向病案编码员的纯本地 ICD 编码核对：依据 GB/T 14396-2016 与公开的 ICD 使用说明，逐份核对 ICD-10 诊断编码与 ICD-9-CM-3 手术操作编码的形态、重复、剑号/星号组合与字段完整性，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——只提示需要编码员关注的配对，不代为判定，编码结论仍由编码员作出。

description.en: Local-only IFC quantity take-off for BIM engineers and cost estimators: read ISO-10303-21 (IFC STEP) text, inventory elements such as walls, slabs, doors and windows with their IfcQuantity values, aggregate length, area and volume by quantity type and export CSV, flagging non-positive values — the source file is left untouched; no network, no model call, no upload.
description.zh: 面向 BIM 工程师与造价员的纯本地 IFC 工程量提取：读 ISO-10303-21（IFC STEP）文本，清点墙/板/门窗等构件与 IfcQuantity 工程量，按计量类型汇总长度、面积、体积并导出 CSV，标出非正数等异常——原文件不动，全程不联网、不调用模型、不上传。

description.en: Image integrity checks for DeepSeek Harness: zero-dependency 8-bit PNG decoding (grey/RGB/RGBA) with mean-threshold block fingerprints and NCC confirmation to find duplicated or mirrored regions inside one figure or shared between two figures, plus REP evidence and Markdown/SARIF reports. Finds reused pixels, not manipulation intent; JPEG is out of
description.zh: 图像完整性核查：零依赖解码 8-bit PNG，用均值阈值分块指纹与 NCC 确认，找出同一图内或两图之间重复或镜像复用的区域，输出 REP 证据与 Markdown/SARIF 报告；只发现像素复用，不推断操纵意图，不支持 JPEG。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with generation history, a prompt template library and an API settings card.
description.zh: AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供生成历史、提示词模板库与 API 设置卡片。

description.en: Local-only import-document check for DeepSeek Harness: read one prepared JSON, cross-check the 9 header fields across the invoice, packing list, bill of lading and customs declaration, list missing items among the declaration's 12 header elements, and export CSV — no network, no model call, no upload.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地进口单证核对：读一份整理好的 JSON，把发票、装箱单、提单、报关单四份单证的 9 个表头字段逐字段对照，并列出报关单 12 项表头要素缺项，可导出 CSV——不联网、不调用模型、不上传。

description.en: Industry and company research pack: methodology skills, industry-chain mapping, public-source policy and news tracking, company research cards and auditable reports.
description.zh: 行业与公司研究包：方法论技能、产业链图谱、公开源政策与新闻跟踪、公司研究卡片，以及可审计的研究报告。

description.en: Invoice ledger check for DeepSeek Harness: per-row detection of duplicate reimbursements, tax/amount arithmetic mismatches, payer mismatches, date anomalies and template placeholders, with a row-locatable anomaly list and a normalised workbook.
description.zh: 面向财务与报销审核的发票台账核对：逐行识别重复报销、价税勾稽不符、抬头不一致、日期异常与模板占位符，输出可定位到行的异常清单与规范化工作簿。

description.en: Local-only ethics-application checklist for DeepSeek Harness: check the application against an 18-item keyword checklist (title, PI, purpose, design, participants, recruitment, consent, assent, risks, benefits, confidentiality, vulnerable groups, compensation, conflicts, retention, dissemination, animal ethics, biosafety) with character locators, derive an advisory risk level and required safeguards from structured flags, and export Markdown + SARIF — it flags missing items; it does not replace the ethics committee.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地伦理审查申请自查：按 18 项关键词清单（题名、负责人、目的、设计、参与者、招募、知情同意、未成年人赞同、风险、获益、保密、弱势群体、补偿、利益冲突、保存、传播、动物伦理、生物安全）逐项核对申请材料并给出字符位置，按结构化标记给出建议性风险等级与相应保障措施，导出 Markdown + SARIF——只提示缺项，不代替伦理委员会作出结论。

description.en: Two chord modes, click and focus: press a chord to surface a letter label over every visible interactive target in the DSH web GUI, then type the label to click or focus it, Vimium-style; label length is derived per round from the candidate count and Escape exits. Focus mode ships disabled until you record a chord in settings, and the click chord is remappable there too.
description.zh: 点击与聚焦两组组合键：按下后 DSH Web 界面里每个可见的可交互目标都会浮出一个字母标签，敲标签即可点击或聚焦它，类似 Vimium；标签长度按候选数量每轮推导，Esc 退出。聚焦模式默认关闭，需在设置页录制和弦后启用，点击组合键也可在设置中修改。

description.en: Points DSH's built-in web_search and web_fetch tools at Keenable, with no API key or account, so web search works with any model, local ones included; it adds no new tools. web_search returns ranked results with a page excerpt and the publication date when known; web_fetch retrieves the page on Keenable's servers and returns it as markdown, refusing localhost and private addresses. Installing pins the host's searchProvider and fetchProvider to keenable; uninstalling restores the host defaults. Keyless use is limited to 10 requests per second and 1,000 per hour per IP, shared by everyone behind the same egress IP; setting the optional KEENABLE_API_KEY environment variable before starting DSH lifts the limit. Queries and fetched URLs are sent to Keenable.
description.zh: 把 DSH 内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具接到 Keenable：无需 API key、无需账号，任何模型（包括本地模型）都能联网搜索，不新增工具。web_search 返回排序后的结果、页面摘录和已知的发布日期；web_fetch 在 Keenable 服务器端抓取页面并返回 markdown，不抓取 localhost 与内网地址。安装时把宿主的 searchProvider 和 fetchProvider 固定为 keenable，卸载后恢复宿主默认值。免 key 调用每个 IP 限 10 次/秒、1000 次/小时（同一出口 IP 下的用户共用这一额度），启动 DSH 前设置可选的环境变量 KEENABLE_API_KEY 即可解除限制。搜索词和抓取的 URL 会发送给 Keenable。

description.en: Local-only labor-contract review for HR and legal ops: check nine required clauses, the probation cap, the 80% probation-pay floor, batch expiry and non-compete compensation hints, and export a sha256-stamped issue-list CSV — no network, no model call, not legal advice.
description.zh: 面向 HR 与法务的纯本地劳动合同体检：核对九项必备条款覆盖、试用期上限、试用期工资 80% 下限、批量到期与竞业限制提示，导出一份带 sha256 的问题清单 CSV——不联网、不调用模型、不构成法律意见。

description.en: Local legal-citation check for lawyers and legal ops: verify statute names, article numbers, quoted text and validity status in citation lists plus document elements, and output a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list — every rule names its source, and it reports literal differences only; no statute-database lookup, no compliance verdict, originals untouched.
description.zh: 面向律师与法务的纯本地法条引用核对：逐处核对引用清单的法律名称、条号、引文与效力状态，以及文书要素，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的差异清单——规则包逐条写明依据来源，只列字面差异，不查法规库、不下合规结论、不改原件。

description.en: Laya typed decisions (noul yes/no, choice, score) as a first-class Cordis service ctx.laya plus the model-visible laya_ask and laya_plan tools that return labels, calibrated probabilities and scale positions instead of prose, with state kept on this machine. The plugin installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a laya-mcp serve sidecar you start yourself and reports when the sidecar is not running.
description.zh: 把 Laya 的有类型决策（noul 是/否、choice、score）接成一等 Cordis 服务 ctx.laya 与两个模型可见工具 laya_ask、laya_plan：只回标签、标定概率与刻度位置，state 不出本机。插件不安装也不下载任何东西，是自启 laya-mcp serve 边车的客户端，边车未运行会明确报出。

description.en: Local letter-of-credit document check for LC examiners: read the L/C header and line items, apply a versioned rule pack to check document types, copies, periods and the internal consistency of header fields and dates, and list only the differences (error / warn / skipped) — no compliance verdict, no liability finding, no network, originals untouched.
description.zh: 面向信用证审单岗的纯本地交单核对：读入信用证表头与逐条条款，用版本化规则包核对单据种类、份数、期限以及表头与日期的内部一致性，只列差异（error / warn / skipped）——不判合规、不认定责任、不联网、不改原件。

description.en: Local-only competency-gap and development-plan register check: following published guidance on competence management and people development, verify that each gap names its post and skill, that recorded levels parse as numbers, that the gap equals required minus actual, that a gap beyond the configured threshold carries a development action with owner and deadline, that completion is not later than the deadline and that status comes from the institution's vocabulary — a row-by-row, column-by-column difference list; no competence verdict, the original is read-only.
description.zh: 面向人力资源与培训管理的纯本地能力差距与培养计划台账核对：依据能力管理与人员发展指南，核对每项差距是否写明岗位与能力项、现有等级是否可解析为数值、差距是否等于要求等级减现有等级、超过配置阈值的差距是否填写培养措施、措施是否写明责任人与完成期限、完成日期是否不晚于期限、状态是否取自本机构口径，输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么」的清单——不判定员工是否胜任，原件只读。

description.en: Contract clause work for DeepSeek Harness: split contract text into a clause tree by leading numbering, map each clause to 12 keys across risk/control/commercial/performance using heading and body keywords, report gaps and numbering problems, and export the unresolved report — 5 legal.* tools, fully local with no network calls and no model calls.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的合同条款处理：按行首编号把合同文本拆成条款树，用标题与正文关键词把每条映射到风险/控制/商务/履约四类共 12 个键，报告缺口与编号问题，并导出未决清单——5 个 legal.* 工具，全程本地、不联网、不调用模型。

description.en: Local-only legal-request intake: read legal requests from EML, parse the headers and deduplicate by Message-ID and thread, classify each request as NDA / MSA / contract review / dispute / compliance / other with keywords, record it in the local ledger and export an Excel sheet — no mailbox connection, no network, no model call, the original EML and attachment manifest stay read-only, and the legal conclusion remains with the reviewer.
description.zh: 面向法务运营的纯本地法务需求收件：从 EML 读取客户或供应商的法务需求，解析邮件头并按 Message-ID 与线程去重，用关键词把需求归入 NDA / MSA / 合同审查 / 争议 / 合规 / 其他，写入本地台账并导出 Excel——不连邮箱、不联网、不调用模型，原始 EML 与附件清单只读，需求结论仍由法务人员作出。

description.en: Local document knowledge base for the workspace: add, list and search a library with hybrid semantic and keyword retrieval, diversity re-ranking, citation-aware injection and integrity checks, over a local SQLite index with no model downloads.
description.zh: 工作区本地文档知识库：添加、列出与检索资料，混合语义与关键词召回、多样性重排、带引用注入与完整性校验，索引存在本地 SQLite，不下载任何模型。

description.en: Theme backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness — translucent surfaces with image or local video backgrounds. Supports DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.2.
description.zh: 主题背景：官方风格折叠设置、通透界面与本地图片/视频背景。支持 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.2。

description.en: Deterministic literature harvesting for DeepSeek Harness: query OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv and Europe PMC in one call, dedupe by DOI → arXiv id → normalized title, resolve open-access links through Unpaywall, report quota and subtopic coverage with explicit gaps and next queries, and land the bounded harvest run record in REP — no LLM in the loop, no scraping, no paywall bypass.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性文献检索：一次并发查询 OpenAlex、Crossref、arXiv 与 Europe PMC，按 DOI → arXiv id → 归一化标题去重合并，经 Unpaywall 解析开放获取链接，按配额与子主题覆盖度报告显式缺口与下一轮查询，有界采集循环的运行记录落入 REP——循环里不调用 LLM、不抓站、不绕过付费墙。

description.en: Literature watch for DeepSeek Harness: save named Crossref bibliographic queries with time windows, run them against Crossref with a bounded client, keep a seen-DOI store so repeated runs return only genuinely new items, and render a Markdown digest plus SARIF; a watch reports new DOIs in a search window, not relevance or quality.
description.zh: 文献监测：保存带时间窗的命名 Crossref 检索式，按需运行（受限客户端），用已见 DOI 存储让重复运行只返回真正的新条目，输出 Markdown 摘要与 SARIF。监测只报检索窗口内的新 DOI，不评价相关性或质量。

description.en: Puts already-configured provider/model routes into an ordered failover pool: when the current route runs out of quota or hits a 429 rate limit, the next healthy route from a different provider is used in the same turn (same-provider candidates are skipped). A sidebar panel lets you pick and order routes and shows the live route, cooling providers, and recent switches.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里已配置的供应商/模型组成有顺序的轮换池：当前路由额度用尽或遇到 429 限流时，同一轮内自动切到下一条可用路由（跨不同供应商切换；同一供应商内的多个模型不会互相兜底）；侧边栏面板可勾选、排序，并显示当前路由、冷却中的供应商与最近切换记录。

description.en: Configurable DSH-native LLM verifier plugin: pairwise comparison, pivot tournament selection, progress tracking and auto-acceptance gating (verifier_compare/select/track/current_session) with A-T scale scoring and a Web settings page.
description.zh: DSH 原生可配置 LLM 裁判复核插件：成对比较、锦标赛择优、进度判定与自动验收门控（verifier_compare/select/track/current_session），A–T 标尺 + 期望评分，自带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing and cloud fallback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama 接入：模型管理、健康检查、基于规则的本地路由与云端回退。

description.en: Whole-disk file-name search for DSH with a self-built cross-platform index, agent tools and a Web panel; no Everything required. It indexes your home directory by default; the first content search also builds a local full-text index (SQLite in the platform cache directory) of text and source files there (by extension, up to 1 MB each, 200,000 files) and of your recent DSH session messages; locator_export writes a SQLite copy of the index to any absolute path it is given, replacing an existing file when overwrite is true. The engine is a prebuilt Go binary shipped for six platforms (source in engine/), and the plugin makes no network requests.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供自建跨平台索引的全盘文件名搜索，带 agent 工具和 Web 面板，不依赖 Everything：默认索引主目录，首次内容搜索时在本机建全文索引（SQLite，系统缓存目录），引擎是随包的预编译 Go 程序，插件不发任何网络请求。

description.en: HDR gold SSR whale lockup: redraws the sidebar whale, deepseek wordmark and HARNESS plate in polished gold, with a diagonal metal sweep that crosses the whole lockup every three seconds. A geometric mask built from the original vectors decides what is lit, so the dark end of the gold ramp and the plate reflect while the lettering and counters stay dark; the canvas runs rgba16float extended range with a 1600 nit short-time peak at the core.
description.zh: HDR 黄金 SSR 大肥鱼：把侧栏的鲸鱼、deepseek 字标与 HARNESS 铭牌重绘为抛光黄金材质，并有一道斜向金属光带每三秒完整掠过整个组合。光带按原始矢量生成的几何遮罩判定受光面，暗金笔画与铭牌底板都会反光，铭文与镂空保持不亮；画布走 rgba16float 扩展动态范围，光芯短时峰值瞄准 1600 nit。

description.en: LSP action surface over real language servers: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints and rename.
description.zh: 基于真实语言服务器的 LSP 动作面：诊断、格式化、补全、代码操作、符号、签名帮助、内联提示与重命名。

description.en: Structured long-term memory in local SQLite: CJK-aware search with hybrid BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, updates, merging, confirmation and staleness review, plus global and project scopes. Agent tools and a CLI share one storage engine, with no cloud service or embedding dependency required.
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的结构化长期记忆：CJK 感知检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦相似度混合重排，支持去重、更新、合并、确认与过期复核，以及全局和项目作用域；通过 agent 工具与 CLI 共用同一存储引擎，无需云端服务或 embedding 依赖。

description.en: Shows a Kobe iced-tea side popup and reports per-turn costs or token counts with bundled offline audio. The voice switches between four emotion tiers by amount, and the ten most common amounts in both CNY and USD play as whole-sentence takes (400 takes in total). Uses dsh-cost-meter when present, otherwise estimates each request from native usage and public prices, labeled as an estimate. Includes twenty cost phrases, four token phrases, CNY/USD, two-decimal ceiling rounding and custom previews; no runtime TTS service or API key. The code is MIT-licensed; the bundled Kobe portrait, icons and pre-made voice clips are not redistributed under that MIT grant and are for personal, non-commercial use with this plugin only. When it has to estimate a cost itself it fetches a public price table from raw.githubusercontent.com (Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) and the USD/CNY rate from open.er-api.com, at most once a day, and sends no session data.
description.zh: 每轮结束弹出科比冰红茶人物，离线播报本轮费用或 Token 用量；按金额切换四档情绪语音，人民币与美元各十档常用金额用整句录音播报（共 400 条）。装了 dsh-cost-meter 时优先用它的结果，否则按各请求原生用量与公开单价估算并标明是估算。含二十句金额台词、四句 Token 台词，支持人民币/美元、两位小数向上取整及自定义试听；无需在线语音服务或 API Key。代码按 MIT 授权；随包的科比人物图、图标与预制语音不随 MIT 授权再分发，仅限随插件个人非商业使用。需要自己估算费用时，它最多每天一次从 raw.githubusercontent.com（Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter）取公开价格表、从 open.er-api.com 取美元兑人民币汇率，不发送会话数据。

description.en: Pre-submission checklist for DeepSeek Harness: manuscript structure and declaration statements, keyword-based coverage of starter CONSORT / STROBE / PRISMA items with locators and advice, and a submission-pack scan (manuscript, cover letter, numbered figures with gap detection, tables, supplements, declarations) with JSON/Markdown reports; a checklist, not a compliance verdict.
description.zh: 投稿前核对清单：检查稿件结构与声明（伦理、知情同意、资助、利益冲突、数据可用性等），按关键词核对 CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA 入门条目并给出定位与建议，扫描投稿包（正文、投稿信、编号图件与缺号、表格、补充材料、声明）并输出 JSON/Markdown 报告；是清单，不是合规裁定。

description.en: PII masking middleware for DeepSeek Harness: anonymize names, phones, emails, ID cards, bank cards, keys and addresses to placeholders before requests reach the model, restore them at the display layer, keep the restore table only in memory and a controlled storage domain, never log plaintext, and expose /mask and the mask_test tool.
description.zh: PII 脱敏中间件：请求到达模型前把姓名、电话、邮箱、证件、银行卡、密钥与地址匿名化为占位符，展示层还原；还原表只存在内存与受控存储域，不记录明文，提供 /mask 命令与 mask_test 工具。

description.en: MCP server management plugin: per-working-directory project/global config tiers (project-level travels with the repo, committable to git); the model surface stays at two middleware atomic tools (ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_call) routed by session cwd, so different repos never clash; stdio / streamable-http transports, JSON import and a floating status panel.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理插件：分工作目录维护项目级 / 全局两级 MCP 配置（项目级随仓库走、可提交 git），模型面经中间层恒定两个原子工具（ws_mcp_search / ws_mcp_call）按会话 cwd 路由、不同仓库互不串台；支持 stdio / streamable-http 双传输、JSON 导入与浮窗状态面板。

description.en: Console for the official DSH MCP client: a read-only runtime view (connection status, registered tools, errors, reconnect counts) in /mcp and a Settings tab, plus approval-gated, backed-up server CRUD through cordis.patch.yml and a tool trial console.
description.zh: 官方 MCP 客户端的控制台：/mcp 与设置页 MCP 页签给出只读运行时视图（连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数），并在 cordis.patch.yml 上做走审批、先备份的 server CRUD 与工具试用台。

description.en: Local-only front-sheet (medical record) QC: following 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents, check field completeness and internal logical contradictions between the fields (e.g. a blank record number), and report a line-by-line list of which row, which column, what differs and which clause says so — missing or inconsistent items for human review only; it does not assess clinical correctness.
description.zh: 面向病案质控的纯本地病案首页核对：依据国卫办医发〔2016〕24号等公开文件，核对首页各字段的齐备性与字段间的逻辑矛盾（如病案号为空），输出「哪一行、哪一栏、差什么、依据哪条」的清单——只列出缺失或不一致之处供人复核，不评价临床正确性。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed ctx.memory seam, a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a memory tool and frozen snapshot injection.
description.zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：typed ctx.memory 服务、零依赖 SQLite 存储、memory 工具与冻结快照注入。

description.en: Project persistent memory and session-lessons distillation: memoir_record / memoir_read tools with BM25-ranked retrieval, per-turn auto-distill, a memory diagnostics panel and cross-project search - fully local, no external dependency.
description.zh: 项目持久化记忆与会话经验沉淀：memoir_record / memoir_read 工具（BM25 相关度排序检索）、每轮工作自动蒸馏、记忆诊断面板与跨项目全局检索，纯本地零外部依赖。

description.en: Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search.
description.zh: 按项目作用域持久化的键值记忆，支持增删查列与搜索。

description.en: dsh-memory-engine is a local memory plugin: it captures facts worth remembering from chat, fades them along a forgetting curve, links them by shared keywords, and renders a rotatable, clickable graph with search, edit, delete and export. Session import is on by default (up to 200 user messages every 60 minutes, with work-instruction and duplicate filtering); automatic memory capture is off by default. Data stays on this machine as plain JSON under ~/.dsh/memory-engine and is never uploaded.
description.zh: 本地记忆插件 dsh-memory-engine：聊天时自动记下值得记的事，按遗忘曲线变淡，共享关键词自动连线，图谱可旋转、可点选、可搜索；支持编辑、删除、导出。默认开启会话导入（每 60 分钟最多 200 条，只取用户消息，自动过滤工作指令与重复内容），自动记忆默认关闭。数据只写本机 ~/.dsh/memory-engine 的 JSON 文件，明文、不上传。

description.en: Meta-analysis arithmetic for DeepSeek Harness: effect-size conversions (OR/RR/d/r/SMD, SE from CI) with named formulas, fixed-effect and DerSimonian–Laird random-effects pooling, Q/df/p, I2, tau2, forest-plot data, Markdown/SARIF reports and a light Egger test at k >= 10; local, dependency-free and reproducible from the inputs.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的元分析算术：效应量换算（OR/RR/d/r/SMD，由 CI 求 SE）并注明公式，固定效应与 DerSimonian-Laird 随机效应合并，Q/df/p、I²、τ²、森林图数据，Markdown/SARIF 报告与 k≥10 的轻量 Egger 检验；纯本地、零依赖、可由输入复算。

description.en: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump; full-session list, in-session and cross-session search, #msg= deep-link bookmarks, keyboard navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的圆点时间轴：每条提问一个圆点，悬停查看内容与元信息（时间、轮次、耗时、TTFT、token），点击即跳转；附带全会话消息列表、站内与跨会话搜索、书签深链接（#msg=）和键盘导航。

description.en: A cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin integrating the Mnemon CLI: profiles, working memory, project documents and long-term Memory Spaces, with import and export.
description.zh: 与 Mnemon CLI 集成的跨 Agent、本地优先持久记忆插件：用户画像 / 工作记忆 / 项目档案与长期 Memory Spaces，支持导入导出。

description.en: Parallel HTTP Range downloads inside DSH with a sidebar panel, composer progress strip, resume, custom headers, mirrors, SHA-256 checks, rate limiting and an agent tool.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内用 HTTP Range 分片并发下载文件：侧边栏面板、对话进度条、断点续传、自定义请求头、镜像回退、SHA-256 校验、限速与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Notebook reproducibility capture for DeepSeek Harness: reads .ipynb JSON without executing it, reports kernel/language, code vs markdown cells, execution order (out-of-order and never-run cells), imports, runtime installs, seeds, absolute paths and output state; hashes the notebook and environment declarations; writes REP evidence and a record; renders a Markdown capture card and SARIF.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Notebook 复现采集：不执行、只读取 .ipynb，报告内核与语言、代码/文本单元、执行顺序（乱序与从未运行）、import、运行时安装、随机种子、绝对路径与输出状态，并对 notebook 与环境声明做哈希，输出 REP 证据、Markdown 采集卡与 SARIF。

description.en: Approval / completion / error event notifications: browser Notification API plus native OS toasts (Windows PowerShell WinRT, Linux and macOS notify-send, zero dependencies); configurable sound, error merging, quiet hours, notification history and a settings panel; falls back to in-page banners outside secure contexts.
description.zh: 审批/完成/错误事件通知：浏览器 Notification + 系统原生 toast（Windows PowerShell WinRT / Linux·macOS notify-send，零依赖）；提示音可配、错误同类合并、免打扰时段、通知历史与配置面板；非安全上下文自动降级横幅。

description.en: For DSH Web 0.2.x within the range >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 (real page acceptance ran on 0.2.2-alpha.2; 0.2.2-rc.1 passed the read-only host contract probe with 7 checks). Explicitly expanding selected native chat regions appends local EPUB, TXT and Markdown novel passages below real content. Per-book progress; no novel text sent to the model, no standalone reader, text-only EPUB.
